Patched the existing `officeqa-capital-movements-country-liabilities-fx` skill with a "Plain-USD variant" section.

The question was CORRECT and was already covered by an existing skill (the Capital Movements per-country liabilities pattern). The one generalizable nuance worth saving: this was a no-FX variant where the answer was requested in billions rather than a foreign currency. Two reusable points now captured in the skill:

1. "in billions" requires scaling the source $-millions value ÷1000 (90,830 millions → 90.83 billions); the default table unit is $ millions, only scale when the requested unit differs.
2. "CY1986" with no month named → use the December year-end column; and don't invent an FX rate when the answer unit is plain dollars.

No new skill or memory entry needed beyond this patch — memory is near capacity and this nuance fits naturally in the already-relevant skill.
